items.text: Different rooms ask the same question for different reasons.
These are shapes to adapt, not scripts to memorise.
A title says you passed exams.
I kept the accounts for my father's shop during exams and found a gap between the cash book and the bank.
Why it works It names a real task, a result and a direction without praising pay.
What you say in the interview should point at a real path.
Needs trust and steady clients, so build experience first.
Who pays you Individuals, small businesses and startups who need continuing help.
